name: WARNING: Commercial Green Wasabi Paste (Horseradish Chemical Mucosal Burn)
whyItWorks: Nearly all sushi bar wasabi is not real wasabi root; it is a blend of grated horseradish powder, mustard flour, artificial green dyes, and citric acid. The volatile isothiocyanates cause intense chemical burns on contact with inflamed esophageal and intestinal mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always request 'Sabi-nuki' (NO wasabi on your sushi or inside rolls), and push the green wasabi dollop off your plate.
